card.name: Words before a level or range
card.fires_on: Small modifier or linking words that come right before a target level, range or change in a measured value, such as desired, excessive, achieve, the and of. Seen in dosing and lab-monitoring text about sodium, blood pressure and drug concentrations.

modes.label: Modifier before a level
modes.description: Words like desired or excessive placed before level or reduction of a measured value.
modes.example: as needed to achieve the<< desired>> level of serum sodium

modes.label: Excessive effect
modes.description: The word excessive before a drop in blood pressure or hypotension.
modes.example: may occasionally experience an<< excessive>> reduction of blood pressure

modes.label: Linking word before a range
modes.description: The or of just before a normal range or rate of correction.
modes.example: slower rates<< of>> correction may be advisable

card.writes: It seems to suppress a following word like pattern, bounds or break, so the text continues with a level, range or reduction instead.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a target level or amount, such as desired level or excessive drop.
